_comment: Mutation testing for the modules that hold credentials and gate publishing. Coverage says a line ran; mutation testing says an assertion would have noticed it change. See docs/mutation-testing.md for why the scope is these three files.
_thresholds_comment: break is a ratchet set just under the measured score, not a target. 36.41% is what these tests actually achieve today; the number is here so the score cannot fall without failing the build. Raise it as the score improves — never lower it to make a red build green.
